General Admission
DETAILS
75+ bands on five music stages
Celebrity and chef performances on the Culinary Stage
Access to gourmet food from Napa Valley’s finest chefs and restaurateurs, plus fine wines, craft beers, custom cocktails, mocktails & N/A offerings
Access to experiences beyond the music! Dance at The Club and the Silent Disco by Allianz, sip in the Wine Garden and refresh at The Beauty Bar by Ulta Beauty.
Free Wi-Fi powered by Cisco
3-day general admission pass holders also receive in-and-out privileges
Access special offers at Napa Valley wineries with Encore Tastings. 
3-day ticket purchasers* get exclusive access to purchase up to 6 GA tickets for the 2028 festival during the renewal presale**
General admission is available as a 3-day or 1-day pass. 
*2027 Ticket purchase must have been made through the BottleRock Front Gate Tickets website to qualify for the renewal presale.​
**Pre-sales take place prior to the lineup announcement and offer 3-day tickets only.
CLOSE
VIP
MORE INFO
VIP
DETAILS
As a BottleRock VIP, you’ll enjoy everything that the general admission pass provides plus:
Separate fast lane entrances
In-and-out privileges
Prime viewing areas at each stage, including shaded elevated viewing lounges at the Main Stage and Second Stage
Easy access corridor between the Main Stage and Second Stage
Access to VIP Village, which includes:
Exclusive live musical performances
Ample lounge seating & shaded eating areas
Premium bars offering an array of Napa Valley fine wines, craft beers, custom cocktails, mocktails & N/A offerings
Expanded culinary offerings
Upgraded air-conditioned restrooms
Free Wi-Fi powered by Cisco
Access special offers at Napa Valley wineries with Encore Tastings. 
3-day ticket purchasers* get exclusive access to purchase up to 2 VIP tickets for the 2028 festival during the renewal presale**
VIP is available as a 3-day or 1-day pass. Watch the VIP experience video 
here
.
*2027 Ticket purchase must have been made through the BottleRock Front Gate Tickets website to qualify for the renewal presale.​
**Pre-sales take place prior to the lineup announcement and offer 3-day tickets only.
CLOSE
Skydeck
MORE INFO
Skydeck
DETAILS
A truly elevated experience. Our Skydeck guests enjoy everything that the VIP pass provides plus:
Access to exclusive, elevated and shaded viewing lounges with unparalleled views of the Main Stage, Culinary Stage and Second Stage
Comfortable lounge seating & spacious, shaded areas on the Skydecks
All-inclusive beer, cocktails and wine at the Skydeck bars
Refresh station with complimentary amenities and cell phone charging
Free Wi-Fi powered by Cisco
In-and-out privileges
Access special offers at Napa Valley wineries with Encore Tastings. 
Exclusive access to purchase up to 2 Skydeck tickets* for the 2028 festival during the renewal presale**
The Skydeck experience is available as a 3-day pass only. Watch the Skydeck experience video 
here
.
*2027 Ticket purchase must have been made through the BottleRock Front Gate Tickets website to qualify for the renewal presale.​
**Pre-sales take place prior to the lineup announcement and offer 3-day tickets only.
CLOSE
Marriott Bonvoy® American Express VIP Viewing Suite
MORE INFO
Marriott Bonvoy® American Express VIP Viewing Suite
DETAILS
Guests in the Marriott Bonvoy® American Express VIP Viewing Suite will enjoy:
Elevated and unobstructed views of the Main Stage
Dedicated VIP entrances with in-and-out privileges to the festival
Access to the VIP Village, the Marriott Bonvoy® American Express VIP Viewing Suite and designated VIP viewing areas at applicable stages
Specially curated bites and signature dishes from world renowned Chef Ken Frank of Napa’s La Toque
All-inclusive beer, specialty cocktails, and wine at the Marriott Bonvoy® American Express VIP Viewing Suite bar. Must be 21+ to drink alcohol. Please drink responsibly.
Special Marriott Bonvoy® American Express® Card Member-only gift
Free Wi-Fi powered by Cisco
This unique experience is available exclusively to Marriott Bonvoy American Express Basic U.S. Cardholders only with the following eligible cards: 
Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant® American Express® Card
, 
Marriott Bonvoy® American Express® Card
, 
Marriott Bonvoy Business® American Express® Card
, 
Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card
. The Marriott Bonvoy® American Express VIP Viewing Suite experience is available as a 3-day or 1-day pass. 1-day passes will be available for purchase at a later date. VIP Viewing suite passes are limited to [2] tickets per Card Member per ticket type. Card Members must present their wristband and their Marriott Bonvoy® American Express® Card in order to gain access to the event; each additional ticket holder in your party must present their wristband. Terms apply.

MORE INFO
The Suites by Workday
DETAILS
A true view from the top! Suites guests enjoy all the benefits of VIP as well as:
An exclusive, private, turn-key suite for 40-60 VIP or Platinum guests per day
Elevated, unobstructed views of the Main Stage
Shaded lounge and entertainment areas
In-suite amplified speakers for optimal sound
In-suite HD video screens for additional Main Stage viewing
Hosted in-suite bar with beer, wine and cocktails provided
In-suite catering from top Napa Valley restaurants
Suites-only corridor for easy access to and from Suites to VIP Village and Second Stage
Free Wi-Fi powered by Cisco
In-and-out privileges
Access special offers at Napa Valley wineries with Encore Tastings. 
Contact us
 to learn more. Watch the Suites experience video 
here
.

Platinum by Prudential
MORE INFO
Platinum by Prudential
DETAILS
Platinum guests receive all VIP and Skydeck benefits as well as:
Backstage parking and entrance for easy festival entry and exit
Exclusive on-stage, front row and sound mix viewing areas
Special celebrity Meet & Greets, based on celebrity availability
Exclusive access to the Platinum Lounge featuring:
Locally sourced premium cuisine
World-class wines selected and served by Master Sommeliers & Masters of Wine
Premium artisanal cocktails & craft beer
High-end specialty spirit tastings
Reservation assistance for lodging, airport transfers and transportation to & from the festival. Contact your platinum concierge team to learn more.
On-site concierge services, air-conditioned spaces, premium restrooms, and complimentary lockers to store personal belongings.
Free Wi-Fi powered by Cisco
In-and-out privileges
Access special offers at Napa Valley wineries with Encore Tastings. 
Exclusive access to purchase up to 2 Platinum tickets* for the 2028 festival during the renewal presale**
The Platinum experience is available as a 3-day pass only and is extremely limited, providing the ultimate luxury festival experience. Watch the Platinum experience video 
here
.
*2027 Ticket purchase must have been made through the BottleRock Front Gate Tickets website to qualify for the renewal presale.​
**Pre-sales take place prior to the lineup announcement and offer 3-day tickets only.
